# GameGuide-AI

> Real-time AI gaming intelligence built for ranked players. Sub-400ms responses powered by a self-healing 4-provider neural mesh.

## Features

- **Neural Mesh Routing** — 4 AI providers with automatic token-level fallback
- **PULSE Web Search** — Live multi-source intel fused from Wikipedia, Steam, Reddit, and RSS
- **Vision GODMODE** — Screenshot-grade build/comp analysis from uploaded images
- **Slash Commands** — `/build`, `/counter`, `/price`, `/lore`, `/help` and more
- **Live Price Intel** — Real-time game prices across 20+ storefronts via CheapShark
- **Persona Engine** — Tactical, casual, or competitive tone — adapts to the player
- **Discord Bot** — Same intelligence, native in your Discord server

## Usage

GameGuide-AI is a free-to-use web application at [gameguide-ai.vercel.app](https://gameguide-ai.vercel.app).  
No account required for basic queries. Sign in to unlock conversation history and preferences.
